name: InterContinental Bahrain
positioning: Luxury city hotel in the heart of Manama, a short walk from Bahrain Financial Harbour
best_for: Travelers who want a walkable base near Bahrain Financial Harbour and the World Trade Center
Guests who value club lounge access and a garden-style pool in the city

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Manama.
Bahrain Financial Harbour is a five-minute stroll from the hotel.
The Moda Mall in the Bahrain World Trade Center is a 10-minute walk away.
Al Fateh Mosque is about 2 kilometers from the hotel.
Bahrain National Museum is about 2 kilometers from the hotel.
The Regency Health Club pool is an outdoor pool on the 10th floor of Regency Plaza.
24-hour in-room dining includes a breakfast in bed with both a Bahraini and an international breakfast.
Legendz Steakhouse has private seats and subtle lighting, with a signature steak tartare.
The hotel is Green Key certified.
The hotel hosts weddings in versatile event spaces with experienced planners.

highlights.text: Elements Pool & Lounge is a green oasis in the heart of Manama with daybeds and poolside tables.
Spa InterContinental offers massages and body scrubs, with sauna and steam rooms.
Club InterContinental guests get complimentary breakfast, afternoon tea and signature cocktails in the Club Lounge, plus exclusive check-in.
Rooms look out across the harbour.

considerations.text: Bahrain International Airport is about 10 kilometers from the hotel.
Pets are not allowed; the concierge can guide guests to an offsite kennel.
WhataHotel notes a formal atmosphere that may not suit casual travelers.
